description.en: Checks whether the player's inventory contains a given item, by its hashed item ID (see CMND_GET_HASH).
CRC32 hash of the item ID to check, from CMND_GET_HASH.

True on any valid call (this always ends by pushing true in the decompiled code, regardless of whether the item is actually present — treat the exact match semantics with caution); null only if the call itself was invalid (no argument given).
